title: Deleting a customer payment needs Invoicing & payments Delete, not Customers Delete
custom_preconds:
1. User A has Customers View/Create & Edit/Delete and Invoicing & payments View and Create & Edit (no Delete).
  2. User B has Customers View and Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments View/Create & Edit/Delete.
custom_steps:
1. As User A, open a customer with payments, open a payment and try to delete it.
  2. As User B, open the same payment and try to delete it.
custom_expected:
User A cannot delete the payment (no delete option).

User B can delete the payment even without Customers Delete.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: deleting a customer payment (gated by Invoicing Delete not Customers Delete) needs the payment delete control located; the Finance-tab payment row menu was not reachable this pass.
